title: Architecture: Movie Data Warehouse & OLAP Solution
description: End-to-end Microsoft BI stack data warehouse for TMDB movie data: Python preprocessing, SSIS ETL loading Star Schema, SSAS MOLAP cube with MDX queries, served via SSRS/Power BI/Excel reporting, with ML revenue prediction extension.

nodes.label: TMDB CSV Dataset
nodes.description: 1.16M movies with 24 columns from Kaggle TMDB v11 dataset (204.7 MB)

nodes.label: Python/Pandas Preprocessing
nodes.description: Null imputation, median zero-replacement, list splitting, feature binning, 57 ML features

nodes.label: SQL Server SSIS
nodes.description: Dimension and fact loading with data flow tasks and constraint management

nodes.label: SQL Server Warehouse
nodes.description: Star Schema: 8 dimension tables (Date, Movie, Genre, Company, Country, Language, Runtime, Adult) + 1 fact table

nodes.label: SSAS MOLAP Cube
nodes.description: Multidimensional cube with 7 measures, 8 dimensions, time hierarchy (Year-Quarter-Month-Day)

nodes.label: SSRS Reports
nodes.description: 3 paginated reports connected via OLEDB-MD data source

nodes.label: Power BI Dashboard
nodes.description: Interactive dashboard (71.5 MB) with movie analytics

nodes.label: Revenue Prediction
nodes.description: SVR model predicting box-office revenue from 57 features, 94.14% accuracy, R2=0.92
